signals.usability_note: A large weeping spruce and a smaller pine block nearly the entire house; only faint glimpses of a white structure and a blurred area are visible behind the branches.
signals.notes: The house is almost entirely hidden behind large evergreens; the visible front strip has patchy grass and bare dirt under the trees, and a paved driveway is on the right, so an in-person or alternate-angle view is needed.
